about_short_description.short_description: Ankr Health uses AI and telemedicine to automate side effect management in cancer and surgical clinics.

product.name: Ankr Cancer Care Companion
product.description: An AI-powered cancer education and navigation app that helps patients understand treatment options, track symptoms and medications, manage side effects, and share health information with caregivers and clinicians.

product.name: Ankr VCX
product.description: An AI workforce platform for medical practices that automates patient communication, symptom and side-effect outreach, and administrative workflows to improve access and support clinical teams.

product.name: Ankr Patient Portal
product.description: A secure web portal for patients, caregivers, and participating healthcare teams to review and share cancer-care information, including notes, symptoms, medications, and personalized clinical content.

product.name: Sol - AI Medical Scribe
product.description: An AI medical scribe application listed by Ankr Health for supporting clinical documentation workflows.
